spans.s: उर m. A sheep.
उरग m. (fem. ˚गी) 1. A snake, अंगुलीवोरगक्षता R.i.28, M.vii.23; 2. a semi-divine serpent usually represented with a human face (in mythology), M.iii.196; 3. lead; 4. the name of a city, R.vi.59.
उरग-अरि, -अशन m. 1. Garuḍa; 2. a peacock.
उरग-अरि, -अशन m. 1. Garuḍa; 2. a peacock.
उरग-प्रतिसर a. having a serpent, for a wedding-ring.
उरग-भूषण m. an epithet of Śiva.
उरग-राज m. the king of snakes.
उरग-सारचंदन m. a kind of sandalwood.
उरग-स्थान n. the abode of the Nāgas, i.e. पाताल.
उरंग n. A snake.
उरंग n. A snake.
उरच्छद n. An armour.
उरण m. (fem. ˚णी) 1. A ram, a sheep, वृकीवोरणमासाद्य मृत्युरादाय गच्छति Bh.; 2. a certain demon slain by Indra.
उरभ्र m. (fem. ˚भ्री) A ram.

उररी ind. 1. A particle implying- (1) assent, admission, acceptance; 2. extension. (It is used as a prefix to the roots, अस्, कृ and भू and is not treated as a separate word; hence we have उररीकृत्य, and not उररी कृत्वा. The word is used in the following forms also- उरी, उरुरी, ऊरी, ऊररी) गिरं न कां कामुररीचकार Bh.V.ii.13.
ऊररी ind. See उररी.
उरस् n. The breast, the bosom, R.i.13, K.S.vi.51.
उरस्-क्षत n. injury to the chest.
उरोज m. the female breast, फेनानामुरसिरुहेषु हारलीला Sis.viii.59, रेजाते रुचिरदृशामुरोजकुंभौ viii.53.

उरस्-छद n. a breast-plate, an armour.
उरसिलोमन् a. having hair on the breast.
उरस्-त्र, -त्राण n. a breast-plate.
उरस्-त्र, -त्राण n. a breast-plate.
उरस्वत् a. broad-chested.
उरस्-सूत्रिका f. a necklace of pearls hanging over the breast.
उरस्-स्थल n. the bosom.
ऊरव्य m. A Vaiśya.

उरसिल a. (f. ला) Broad-chested.

उरस्य (I) a. (f. स्या) 1. Legitimate, born from a married couple of the same tribe and caste; 2. excellent.
